<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">This is a <em>fast</em> and <em>lightweight</em> package that counts the number of atoms in a given <code>BioSequence</code> object. It was inspired by the <a href="https://github.com/juanvillada/Biocost.jl/tree/main">Biocost.jl</a> package.</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Installation</h2><a id="user-content-installation" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Installation" href="#installation"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">
BioAtomsCount is a  
    <a href="https://julialang.org" rel="nofollow">
        <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuliaLang/julia-logo-graphics/master/images/julia.ico" width="16em" style="max-width: 100%;">
        Julia Language
    </a>
      package. To install BioAtomsCount,
    please <a href="https://docs.julialang.org/en/v1/manual/getting-started/" rel="nofollow">open
    Julia's interactive session (known as REPL)</a> and press <kbd>]</kbd>
    key in the REPL to use the package mode, then type the following command
</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="pkg&gt; add BioAtomsCount"><pre>pkg<span class="pl-k">&gt;</span> add BioAtomsCount</pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Usage</h2><a id="user-content-usage" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Usage" href="#usage"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The <code>BioAtomsCount</code> module exports a single function <code>countatoms</code> which takes a <code>BioSequence</code> object as input and returns a matrix of the count of atoms in the sequence.</p>
<p dir="auto">Each column of the matrix corresponds to a different atom (C, H, N, O) for DNA and (C, H, N, O, S) for proteins and each row corresponds to a different residue in the sequence.</p>
<p dir="auto">Here is an example of a DNA sequence:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="using BioSequences

phi = dna&quot;&quot;

countatoms(phi)

4×4 Matrix{Int64}:
#   C     H     N     O    
 6455  6455  6455     0  # A
 4628  5785  3471  1157  # C
 6270  6270  6270  1254  # G
 8420  8420  3368  3368  # T"><pre><span class="pl-k">using</span> BioSequences

phi = dna""

<span class="pl-c1">countatoms</span>(phi)

<span class="pl-c1">4</span><span class="pl-k">×</span><span class="pl-c1">4</span> Matrix{Int64}<span class="pl-k">:</span>
<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span>   C     H     N     O    </span>
 <span class="pl-c1">6455</span>  <span class="pl-c1">6455</span>  <span class="pl-c1">6455</span>     <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> A</span>
 <span class="pl-c1">4628</span>  <span class="pl-c1">5785</span>  <span class="pl-c1">3471</span>  <span class="pl-c1">1157</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> C</span>
 <span class="pl-c1">6270</span>  <span class="pl-c1">6270</span>  <span class="pl-c1">6270</span>  <span class="pl-c1">1254</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> G</span>
 <span class="pl-c1">8420</span>  <span class="pl-c1">8420</span>  <span class="pl-c1">3368</span>  <span class="pl-c1">3368</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> T</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Now an example of a protein sequence:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="lambdaprotein = aa&quot;MEVNKKQLADIFGASIRTIQNWQEQGMPVLRGGGKGNEVLYDSAAVIKWYAERDAEIENEKLRREVEELRQASEADLQPGTIEYERHRLTRAQADAQELKNARDSAEVVETAFCTFVLSRIAGEIASILDGLPLSVQRRFPELENRHVDFLKRDIIKAMNKAAALDELIPGLLSEYIEQSG*&quot;

countatoms(lambdaprotein)

20×5 Matrix{Int64}:
#  C    H   N   O  S
  60  140  20  40  0  # A (Ala)
  90  210  60  30  0  # R (Arg)
  28   56  14  21  0  # N (Asn)
  40   70  10  40  0  # D (Asp)
   3    7   1   2  1  # C (Cys)
  50   90  10  40  0  # Q (Gln)
 110  220  44  66  0  # E (Glu)
  22   55  11  22  0  # G (Gly)
  12   18   6   4  0  # H (His)
  78  169  13  26  0  # I (Ile)
 108  234  18  36  0  # L (Leu)
  54  126  18  18  0  # K (Lys)
  15   33   3   6  3  # M (Met)
  45   55   5  10  0  # F (Phe)
  25   45   5  10  0  # P (Pro)
  27   63   9  27  0  # S (Ser)
  20   45   5  15  0  # T (Thr)
  22   24   4   4  0  # W (Trp)
  36   44   4  12  0  # Y (Tyr)
  50  110  10  20  0  # V (Val)"><pre>lambdaprotein <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds"><span class="pl-c1">aa</span>"</span>MEVNKKQLADIFGASIRTIQNWQEQGMPVLRGGGKGNEVLYDSAAVIKWYAERDAEIENEKLRREVEELRQASEADLQPGTIEYERHRLTRAQADAQELKNARDSAEVVETAFCTFVLSRIAGEIASILDGLPLSVQRRFPELENRHVDFLKRDIIKAMNKAAALDELIPGLLSEYIEQSG*<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>

<span class="pl-c1">countatoms</span>(lambdaprotein)

<span class="pl-c1">20</span><span class="pl-k">×</span><span class="pl-c1">5</span> Matrix{Int64}<span class="pl-k">:</span>
<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span>  C    H   N   O  S</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">60</span>  <span class="pl-c1">140</span>  <span class="pl-c1">20</span>  <span class="pl-c1">40</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> A (Ala)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">90</span>  <span class="pl-c1">210</span>  <span class="pl-c1">60</span>  <span class="pl-c1">30</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> R (Arg)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">28</span>   <span class="pl-c1">56</span>  <span class="pl-c1">14</span>  <span class="pl-c1">21</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> N (Asn)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">40</span>   <span class="pl-c1">70</span>  <span class="pl-c1">10</span>  <span class="pl-c1">40</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> D (Asp)</span>
   <span class="pl-c1">3</span>    <span class="pl-c1">7</span>   <span class="pl-c1">1</span>   <span class="pl-c1">2</span>  <span class="pl-c1">1</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> C (Cys)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">50</span>   <span class="pl-c1">90</span>  <span class="pl-c1">10</span>  <span class="pl-c1">40</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Q (Gln)</span>
 <span class="pl-c1">110</span>  <span class="pl-c1">220</span>  <span class="pl-c1">44</span>  <span class="pl-c1">66</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> E (Glu)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">22</span>   <span class="pl-c1">55</span>  <span class="pl-c1">11</span>  <span class="pl-c1">22</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> G (Gly)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">12</span>   <span class="pl-c1">18</span>   <span class="pl-c1">6</span>   <span class="pl-c1">4</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> H (His)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">78</span>  <span class="pl-c1">169</span>  <span class="pl-c1">13</span>  <span class="pl-c1">26</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> I (Ile)</span>
 <span class="pl-c1">108</span>  <span class="pl-c1">234</span>  <span class="pl-c1">18</span>  <span class="pl-c1">36</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> L (Leu)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">54</span>  <span class="pl-c1">126</span>  <span class="pl-c1">18</span>  <span class="pl-c1">18</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> K (Lys)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">15</span>   <span class="pl-c1">33</span>   <span class="pl-c1">3</span>   <span class="pl-c1">6</span>  <span class="pl-c1">3</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> M (Met)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">45</span>   <span class="pl-c1">55</span>   <span class="pl-c1">5</span>  <span class="pl-c1">10</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> F (Phe)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">25</span>   <span class="pl-c1">45</span>   <span class="pl-c1">5</span>  <span class="pl-c1">10</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> P (Pro)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">27</span>   <span class="pl-c1">63</span>   <span class="pl-c1">9</span>  <span class="pl-c1">27</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> S (Ser)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">20</span>   <span class="pl-c1">45</span>   <span class="pl-c1">5</span>  <span class="pl-c1">15</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> T (Thr)</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">22</span>   <span class="pl-c1">24</span>   <span class="pl-c1">4</span>   <span class="pl-c1">4</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> W (Trp)</span>

  <span class="pl-c1">50</span>  <span class="pl-c1">110</span>  <span class="pl-c1">10</span>  <span class="pl-c1">20</span>  <span class="pl-c1">0</span>  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> V (Val)</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Sometimes what is needed is the total number of each atom in the sequence. This can be achieved by a simple sum of the matrix:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="counts = countatoms(lambdaprotein)

sum(counts, dims=1)

1×5 Matrix{Int64}:
#  C     H    N    O  S
 895  1814  270  449  4"><pre>counts <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">countatoms</span>(lambdaprotein)

<span class="pl-c1">sum</span>(counts, dims<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">1</span>)

<span class="pl-c1">1</span><span class="pl-k">×</span><span class="pl-c1">5</span> Matrix{Int64}<span class="pl-k">:</span>
<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span>  C     H    N    O  S</span>
 <span class="pl-c1">895</span>  <span class="pl-c1">1814</span>  <span class="pl-c1">270</span>  <span class="pl-c1">449</span>  <span class="pl-c1">4</span></pre></div>
